description: This file contains test utilities and mock matchers for HTTP/2 frame testing using Google Mock, including custom matchers for frame headers and specific frame types.

classes.name: FrameHeaderMatcher
classes.description: Custom matcher for verifying frame header fields in nghttp2 frames.

classes.name: PointerToFrameHeaderMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for nghttp2 frame header pointers.

classes.name: ReferenceToFrameHeaderMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for nghttp2 frame header references.

classes.name: DataMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for nghttp2 data frames with specific properties.

classes.name: HeadersMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for nghttp2 header frames with specific properties.

classes.name: RstStreamMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for RST_STREAM frames with specific stream ID and error code.

classes.name: SettingsMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for SETTINGS frames with specific settings values.

classes.name: PingMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for PING frames with specific ID and acknowledgment flag.

classes.name: GoAwayMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for GOAWAY frames with specific last stream ID, error code, and opaque data.

classes.name: WindowUpdateMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for WINDOW_UPDATE frames with specific delta.
